decision_conditions:
The works to which this Listed Building Consent relates must be begun before the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 18 of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
description:
General upgrade of property including:
Urgent repairs and replacement where necessary of significantly decayed timber roof structure and walls to front / south-west elevation, including removal and reinstatement of roof tiles and reconstruction of approx 10 courses of brick parapet front elevation wall. 
New lead gutter behind parapet.
New lead roof and cheeks to dormer windows
New larger capacity cast iron rainwater goods to rear.
Removal of areas of damp and disconnected lime plaster from internal walls. Replacement with new lime plaster, or renovation and repairs to defective lath and lime-plaster walls and ceilings. 
Repair and restoration of 3 x sash windows by Ventrolla or similar. Replacement of all other fenestration with painted timber-framed windows, double-glazed with ‘historic-style’ glass.
Removal of asbestos ceiling boarding by specialists. 
Splitting existing rear first floor bathroom into two; shower room accessed from landing and ensuite bathroom accessed via a newly created opening from bedroom 1.
Upgrade of services and utilities, including re-wiring and new plumbing and heating. Relocation of incoming supplies plus electrical and gas meters to front garden of property.
Replacing heavy C20th Redland tile with lighter slate on roof of outrigger kitchen and inserting conservation-style rooflights.
Replacing existing cementitious pointing with new lime mortar on all elevations.
Works to drainage, airbricks, paving and planters in front garden and rear courtyard garden.
